_comment: Copy this file to integrations.json and fill it in. Buckets: off_until_asked (installed, disabled, enabled when you ask), enabled_per_project (on only in the listed projects, matched by folder name), uninstalled (removed on purpose). Entries: kind is plugin, mcp, skill or agent; name is as the harness knows it; optional projects (folder names) and machines (hostnames or profile names; absent means all machines); note is why.
